test_runs.selector: Parallel query determinism, dedupe, budgets, cancellation, errors, schema parity, and immutable-PV integration
negative_cases: Invalid query, worker, timeout, or result limits fail closed before fan-out.
Duplicate requests cannot execute twice or inflate aggregate results.
Completion order cannot change the aggregate receipt.
Timeout, cancellation, and worker error remain explicit per-request statuses.

test_runs.selector: Lane guidance, reader, lane contract, registry, and packaged-skill integration
negative_cases: The new primitive cannot weaken the existing single-lane query and provenance contracts.
Lane aliases and packaged skill references remain bound to canonical public identities.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, schema parse, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check; py_compile; json.tool; git diff --check
negative_cases: Malformed Python, schema JSON, or whitespace cannot pass.
No Git, install, helper, tunnel, candidate, HIL, pointer, or subagent action is included.

limitations: Row216 exposes the internal fan-out primitive only; typed cross-lane joins remain Row217.
Public skill and MCP routing remains Row221.
